dct_description_sm: In this paper, we asked whether the degree of early complexity (minimal, low, moderate, or high), genetic strain (brown vs white feathered), or their interaction affects fear behaviour (type and intensity) in laying hen pullets in different fear-inducing situations: 1) a startle response test, 2) a novel arena, and 3) a novel object test.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Raising Laying Hens: housing complexity and genetic strain affect startle and behavioural response to fear stimuli
